verdict.rationale: Name.com documents a TLD price-list endpoint that returns all supported TLDs with pricing for each supported order type, including retail (public site) pricing, and it has a public pricing page. The evidence does not name registration, renewal and transfer as separate order types, and nothing addresses whether first-year prices are teasers that jump at renewal. missing for 10: explicit per-TLD breakdown of registration vs renewal vs transfer prices, evidence of no first-year teaser or renewal spike, independent corroboration of pricing transparency.

support.subject: As a founder, the full price list is published — registration, renewal, and transfer priced separately per TLD, with no teaser first-year price hiding a renewal spike

citations.quote: This endpoint returns an alphabetical list of all TLDs supported by name.com, including pricing for each supported order type.
name.com provides three pricing types for each TLD: Account-Level Pricing... Original Pricing... Retail Pricing (Public Site Pricing)
